details.command: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$log='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational'; try{$events=Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName=$log;StartTime=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(-10)} -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.Message -like '*WebMCP Recovery Supervisor*'} | Select-Object -First 20 TimeCreated,Id,LevelDisplayName,Message; $events|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress}catch{[pscustomobject]@{error=$_.Exception.Message}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress}"
